The file focus_billing.csv is a FOCUS-format (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) daily cost export. Unless stated otherwise, 'spend' means the sum of BilledCost, and rows of every ChargeCategory are included. What was the total spend in 2026-09 for resources tagged team=payments (Tags column is JSON)? Round to 2 decimals.

Data files in your working directory: focus_billing.csv.

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, json
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
# Determine which period column to use; check BillingPeriodStart values
print(df['BillingPeriodStart'].unique()[:20])
df['tags'] = df['Tags'].apply(lambda s: json.loads(s) if isinstance(s,str) else {})
df['team'] = df['tags'].apply(lambda t: t.get('team'))
m = (df['BillingPeriodStart'].astype(str).str.startswith('2026-09')) & (df['team']=='payments')
print(m.sum(), round(df.loc[m,'BilledCost'].sum(),2))
